hero.subtitle: Strategic partner for the protection of critical infrastructure. From the initial study to final installation, we support every strategic security project with technical expertise and rigor.

servicios.card1_desc: We analyze your infrastructure to design the best security strategy, with technical visits and risk assessment.
servicios.card2_desc: We create tailor-made solutions, selecting the most suitable equipment for your specific needs.
servicios.card3_desc: Our certified technicians install and configure every system with guaranteed professional quality.
servicios.heading: Integrated solutions for critical security
servicios.heading_desc: A technical approach with diagnostics, design, installation and operational support.

expansion.intro: NOVAXIS was founded in Gabès, Tunisia, in 2009 as a physical security engineering company. Since then, it has supported governments, international organizations and industrial complexes in more than 8 countries.
expansion.item1_desc: Creation of NOVAXIS in Tunisia, specialized in physical security, networks and engineering solutions.
expansion.item2_desc: United Nations (UNIOGBIS) in Guinea-Bissau, Sri Lanka Navy and Libya's High National Election Commission (HNEC).
expansion.item3_desc: Protection of government infrastructure and electronic security for strategic infrastructure in Mauritania and Ukraine.
expansion.item4_desc: World Bank in Tunisia, IAEA/ABEN nuclear project in Bolivia and the creation of the NOVAXIS LATAM ENGINEERING subsidiary.
expansion.cta_desc: Do you have a project in Bolivia, Panama, Honduras or Latin America? We'll support you wherever you need it.

sectores.title: We work on the most demanding projects requiring the highest level of security and reliability
sectores.card1_desc: Protection of strategic facilities: energy, telecommunications, transportation and public works.
sectores.card2_desc: Solutions for government agencies, United Nations, World Bank, IAEA and diplomatic missions.
sectores.card3_desc: Perimeter security, access control and supervision for industrial plants and large-scale operations.
sectores.card4_desc: Nuclear technologies, irradiation facilities and specialized scientific equipment supply.
sectores.card5_desc: Electronic security projects for defense forces and naval operations.

nuclear.title: Physical security for nuclear and irradiation facilities
nuclear.desc: We design and integrate physical security systems for nuclear power plants, irradiation facilities and scientific research centers, meeting the highest access control, surveillance and monitoring standards this type of critical infrastructure demands.
nuclear.item1_desc: Biometric and credential-based systems restricting entry to high-sensitivity areas, with full traceability of every access.
nuclear.item2_desc: Continuous coverage of perimeters and critical points, with video analytics for early intrusion detection.
nuclear.item3_desc: Intrusion sensors and centralized control centers enabling an immediate response to any anomaly.
nuclear.item4_desc: Implementations aligned with the security protocols required for nuclear and irradiation infrastructure.

equipo.desc: Our technicians are highly qualified engineers trained in every specialty of the physical security industry.

tecnologias.title: We deploy the best-performing solutions on the market, integrating AI and real-time analysis
tecnologias.card1_desc: IP camera systems with intelligent analytics and real-time video surveillance.
tecnologias.card2_desc: Biometric and electronic access management for facilities.
tecnologias.card3_desc: Alarm and intrusion detection systems with real-time response.
tecnologias.card4_desc: Real-time voice communication and coordination for security operations.
tecnologias.card6_desc: Unified supervision and monitoring rooms for comprehensive operations.
tecnologias.card7_desc: Design and integration of electronic security systems tailored to each facility.
tecnologias.card8_desc: HVAC technical service and preventive maintenance for critical systems.
tecnologias.card9_desc: Supply and installation of specialized scientific and laboratory equipment.

nosotros.title: Physical security engineering for critical infrastructures
nosotros.desc: Founded in 2009 in Gabès (Tunisia), NOVAXIS International is an engineering company specializing in the design, supply, integration, installation and maintenance of physical security solutions for critical infrastructures, government institutions, international organizations and industrial complexes.
nosotros.desc2: We rely on certified engineers and technicians and maintain strategic alliances with the world's leading technology manufacturers.

porque.item2_desc: Engineers and technicians with ISO 9001 certification and manufacturer-level specialization.
